proposals.before: Peng Chong had quarreled with the regional inspector Zhu Fu, brooded on slander, and—on his wife’s advice—defied the recall; he rose against Zhu Fu and was destroyed.
proposals.after: Peng Chong had quarreled with the Shepherd of Youzhou Zhu Fu, brooded on slander, and—on his wife’s advice—defied the recall; he rose against Zhu Fu and was destroyed.
proposals.reason: 幽州牧 is the provincial shepherd/governor (牧), not the regional inspector (刺史).

proposals.before: After two more years the palace carriage feasted its late halt.
proposals.after: After two more years the palace carriage made its late halt.
proposals.reason: 宴驾 is the death euphemism 晏驾; “feasted” mistranslates 宴 and obscures the meaning that the emperor died.

proposals.before: On gengshen in the fifth month Lady Dong’s Yongle apartments beside Deyang Hall caught fire.
proposals.after: On gengshen in the fifth month the Yongle empress dowager’s palace offices inside the northwest entry of the Deyang front hall caught fire.
proposals.reason: Chinese names only 永乐太后; “Lady Dong” is an invented personal name not present in the source unit.

proposals.before: Government was rotten, Liang Ji twisted the law, and the emperor doted on Empress Deng—another season of winged ill omens.
proposals.after: Government was rotten, Liang Ji twisted the law, and the emperor doted on the empress of Bo—another season of winged ill omens.
proposals.reason: 毫后 is the Bo empress; rendering her as “Empress Deng” conflates her with Empress Deng (邓皇后) earlier in the chapter.

decisions.after: Peng Chong had quarreled with Zhu Fu, governor of Youzhou, brooded on slander, and—on his wife’s advice—defied the recall; he rose against Zhu Fu and was destroyed.
decisions.reason: 幽州牧 is the governorship of Youzhou, not the inspectorate; the revised syntax also makes Zhu Fu's name and office clear.
宫车宴驾 is the imperial-death euphemism (晏驾); “feasted” wrongly reads 宴 as a banquet and obscures that the emperor died, while “made its late halt” keeps the calque without that error.
The unit names only 永乐太后 and locates 宫署 inside 德阳前殿西北入门内; “Lady Dong” and “apartments beside Deyang Hall” invent a personal name and misplace the offices.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 德阳前殿西北入门内永乐太后宫署

decisions.after: Government was rotten, Liang Ji twisted the law, and the emperor doted on Empress Bo—another season of winged ill omens.
decisions.reason: 毫后 uses the temporary surname Bo by which Deng Mengnü was known; Empress Bo preserves the source's designation while the person record retains her full identity.
